title: You saved men from drowning. I’m not a hero, however
html_source: Mulligan is known for saving a man from drowning; Stephen says he’s not the type of man to save people. His fear of water makes it doubly unlikely that he would be able to follow Mulligan’s example.

anchor.text: You saved men from drowning. I'm not a hero, however
anchor.prefix:
re you in a funk? 

 — I was, Stephen said with energy and growing fear. Out here in the dark with a man I don't know raving and moaning to himself about shooting a black panther.
anchor.suffix:
. If he stays on here I am off. 

 Buck Mulligan frowned at the lather on his razorblade. He hopped down from his perch and began to search his trouser pockets hastily.
